title: Skirt Steak with Chimichurri Sauce
description: An essential Argentinian classic featuring juicy grilled steak topped with a fresh, zingy parsley, garlic, and oregano chimichurri sauce.
instructions: Place parsley, oregano, garlic, red pepper flakes, red wine vinegar, salt, and black pepper into a food processor. Pulse until finely chopped but not pureed.
Transfer the mixture to a small bowl, pour in the extra virgin olive oil, and stir gently. Set aside for 1 hour to allow flavors to meld.
Remove steak from the refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking to bring to room temperature.
Heat vegetable oil in a heavy skillet or grill over high heat until smoking.
Generously season both sides of the steak with salt and pepper.
Cook the steak for 2 minutes per side for medium-rare or 2.5 minutes per side for medium.
Transfer steak to a plate, cover loosely with foil, and rest for 5 to 10 minutes.
Slice thin against the grain and serve with Chimichurri Sauce on the side.
